source: Chrome DevTools Protocol geometry reads on the served production build

mobile390.note: Below the grid breakpoint the remaining columns (quantity, method, operational status, timing, deadlines) are reached by the grid's own scoped horizontal scroll, which the task explicitly allows; the desktop column widths are not crushed.

readabilityRepairs: AppDataGrid gained a supported rowHeight prop; the work queue renders 64px rows so a badge plus its scope label never clip.
The operational-status cell keeps badge and scope on ONE non-wrapping line; the scope truncates with a title tooltip instead of wrapping into 3-4 lines.
workUnitKindLabel no longer repeats «(بدون گروه پذیرش)» under a badge that already says «بدون گروه پذیرش».
The order column keeps the human order reference (e.g. TB-20261114151709-01-2d8281), not a UUID tail.
